name: List Contacts
description: Lists information from contacts in the given tenant id as per filter parameters.

configurable_props.name: tenantId
configurable_props.label: Tenant ID
configurable_props.description: Select an organization tenant to use, or provide a tenant ID

configurable_props.name: modifiedAfter
configurable_props.label: Modified After
configurable_props.description: Filter by a date. Only contacts modified since this date will be returned. Format: YYYY-MM-DD

configurable_props.name: ids
configurable_props.label: IDs
configurable_props.description: Filter by a comma-separated list of ContactIDs. Allows you to retrieve a specific set of contacts in a single call. See [details.](https://developer.xero.com/documentation/api/contacts#optimised-queryparameters)

configurable_props.name: where
configurable_props.label: Where
configurable_props.description: Filter using the where parameter. We recommend you limit filtering to the [optimised elements](https://developer.xero.com/documentation/api/contacts#optimised-parameters) only.

configurable_props.name: order
configurable_props.label: Order
configurable_props.description: Order by any element returned ([*see Order By.*](https://developer.xero.com/documentation/api/requests-and-responses#ordering))

configurable_props.name: page
configurable_props.label: Page
configurable_props.description: Up to 100 contacts will be returned per call when the page parameter is used e.g. page=1.

configurable_props.name: includeArchived
configurable_props.label: Include Archived
configurable_props.description: e.g. includeArchived=true - Contacts with a status of ARCHIVED will be included in the response.
